description: Behavioral evals for the dynamic `delegate(goal, context, toolsets, skills, timeout_s)` function tool that replaced the static `delegate_agent` AgentTool. Contract: the parent LLM calls `delegate(...)` when work warrants isolation; the tool builds a fresh child agent with the requested toolsets + skill content injected into its prompt and runs it under an isolated InMemorySessionService. NOTE: the project's eval_config.json grades against rubric_based_final_response_quality_v1 only — 'calls delegate' / 'does not call delegate' / 'passes toolsets=X' is encoded via rubric text. The intermediate_data.tool_uses field is declarative documentation of the expected trajectory.
